lumilib.title: LumiLib
lumilib.summary: Shared foundation and hub for Lumitier's mods.
lumilib.hub.title: LumiLib
lumilib.option.show_session.desc: Show your skin head and account name at the top of the hub. Turn it off if you stream or record and would rather not have your account name on screen. LumiLib never displays or stores your session token either way.
lumilib.entry.present: Installed, but not connected to LumiLib.
lumilib.mod.not_linked: This version does not register with LumiLib. Its settings are available through Mod Menu.
lumilib.option.show_missing.desc: List mods that are not installed, greyed out and with a link. Turn it off to see only what is actually running.
lumilib.option.open_mod_menu.desc: Every mod on this instance, not just these.
